title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant Tasks Checklist

groups.name: Daily tasks
items: Call and text every new lead (web, portal, Zillow) within minutes of it arriving
Log every call, text and email in the CRM with a next follow-up date
Clear overdue CRM tasks and work the follow-up smart lists
Triage the inbox and draft routine replies for agent approval
Confirm today's showings, listing appointments and buyer consultations
Check transaction deadlines due in the next 72 hours
Schedule today's social media posts
Send the agent an end-of-day report: leads, appointments, hot leads, blockers

groups.name: Weekly tasks
items: Nurture calls to leads who are 30 to 90 days out
Send each seller their weekly activity report (showings, feedback, views)
Request and log showing feedback from buyer agents
CRM clean-up: stages, tags, duplicates and missing phone numbers
Send the newsletter or a market update email
Review action plans and automations, and pause any that no longer fit
Post an update and photos to the Google Business Profile
Weekly scorecard: new leads, conversations, appointments set and kept, by source

groups.name: Monthly tasks
items: Check-in calls or messages to past clients and sphere
Track commissions and expenses for the bookkeeper
Report on lead sources: cost and appointments per source
Refresh the listing presentation and buyer packet
Send birthday and home-anniversary messages from the database
Ask recent closings for a Google review

groups.name: For every new listing
items: Collect seller documents, disclosures and HOA or condo information
Book photography, video, floor plans and staging
Order the sign, lockbox and print materials
Prepare MLS input and photos for the agent's approval
Draft the listing description and feature sheet
Create just-listed social posts and the email blast
Set up the showing service and showing instructions
Schedule open houses and order open-house materials

groups.name: For every transaction
items: Open the file and build the contract timeline
Send intro emails to clients, lender, title and the other agent
Track every contingency deadline in the calendar
Collect signatures and documents and upload them to the transaction platform
Schedule inspection, appraisal and final walk-through access
Send clients a status update every week until closing
Run the broker compliance checklist before closing
Arrange the closing gift and ask for a review after closing

groups.name: Keep with the licensed agent
items: Pricing advice and opinions of value
Negotiating offers, terms and commission
Explaining or interpreting contracts
Showings and open-house discussions about the property (unless the assistant is licensed)
Anything your state or brokerage reserves for licensees
